caption: The review "food was great" becomes three 3-d word vectors. A width-2 filter scores the pair (food, was) at ReLU(2) = 2 and (was, great) at ReLU(0) = 0, and max-pooling keeps the strongest, 2 — one number per filter, not one per token.

spec.title: Width-2 filter on "food was great"
spec.aria: The review food was great becomes three 3-d word vectors; a width-2 filter gives window 1 (food, was) a score of 2 and window 2 (was, great) a score of 0 after ReLU, and max-pooling keeps 2 as the single feature for this filter.
